title: GPT-ImgEval: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Diagnosing GPT4o in Image Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the image generation and editing performance of GPT-4o across technical datasets (GenEval, Reason-Edit, WISE). While it briefly mentions safety filters and the detectability of AI-generated content for forensic purposes, it does not benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
